configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: Configure filtering settings for the SAP LogServ TA.

entity.label: Enable Filtering
entity.help: Controls whether index-time filtering is active. When enabled, incoming log events are evaluated against the Include, Exclude, and Days in the Past rules below — events that don't pass are routed to nullQueue and never indexed (no license usage). When disabled, all events are indexed regardless of the filter rules. On a single instance, changes take effect immediately after Save. On a deployment server, changes are staged to deployment-apps/ and a Deploy to Forwarders button appears below.

entity.label: Include Filters
entity.help: Allowlist of log types to index, using comma-separated path patterns. Each pattern matches the log type path (e.g., linux/messages, hana/hanaaudit). Only log types matching at least one pattern will be indexed — everything else is dropped. Default: */* (include all). Examples: hana/* (all HANA logs), linux/messages,proxy/squid (specific types only).

validators.errorMsg: Include filters must be less than 4096 characters.

entity.label: Exclude Filters
entity.help: Blocklist of log types to drop, using comma-separated path patterns. Any log type matching an exclude pattern is dropped — even if it also matches an include pattern (exclude always wins). Leave empty to exclude nothing. Examples: linux/cron,linux/kern (drop cron and kernel logs), dns/* (drop all DNS logs).

validators.errorMsg: Exclude filters must be less than 4096 characters.

entity.label: Days in the Past
entity.help: Only index events from the last N days. The cutoff updates every 24 hours and on each Save, creating a rolling window that moves forward daily. Example with Days in the Past = 7: On March 11, events timestamped March 4 or earlier are dropped. The next day (March 12), the window shifts — now events from March 5 or earlier are dropped. An event from March 5 that was indexed on March 11 would be dropped if re-ingested on March 12. Set to 0 to disable (index all events regardless of age). Useful for preventing bulk backfill of historical data during initial setup or recovery.

validators.errorMsg: Days in the Past must be between 0 and 3650.
